verdict: State Street posted record servicing and management fees as total revenue rose 13% to $4.0B and net interest income jumped 21% — profit rose 27% to $1.09B, with no notable items muddying the quarter.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago, to a $4,004M total

kpis.label: Net interest income
kpis.note: +21% YoY, as net interest margin widened 16 basis points to 1.12%

kpis.label: Assets under custody
kpis.note: assets under custody and/or administration; $6.3T under management

segments.name: Servicing fees
segments.note: Fees for custody and administration of clients' assets — a record quarter, with $59.2 trillion under custody and/or administration.

segments.name: Net interest income
segments.note: Interest earned on loans and securities minus interest paid — up 21% as the net interest margin widened to 1.12%.

segments.name: Management fees
segments.note: Fees for managing $6.3 trillion of client assets — a record, driven by higher market levels and $69B of long-term inflows.

segments.name: FX trading services
segments.note: Foreign-exchange trading for clients — record client volumes drove a 17% increase.

segments.name: Software services
segments.note: Software and data for investment managers, including the Charles River platform.

segments.name: Securities finance
segments.note: Lending clients' securities and related prime services, on higher client lending balances.

segments.name: Other fee revenue
segments.note: Remaining fee income — down 29% on market-related adjustments.

opex.name: Compensation
opex.note: Pay and benefits — the bank's biggest cost, up 8% on incentive pay, hiring and merit increases.

opex.name: Information systems
opex.note: Information systems and communications — up 15% on technology and infrastructure investment.

opex.name: Transaction processing
opex.note: Transaction processing services — the cost of processing clients' trades and payments.

opex.name: Occupancy
opex.note: Offices and premises, down 4% as the bank shrinks its real-estate footprint.

opex.name: Other expenses
opex.note: All remaining costs, including professional fees and revenue-related expenses.

footerNote: For a custodian bank, the provision for credit losses plays the role of cost of revenue — this quarter it was a $4M release (a small negative cost) after commercial loan sales and repayments. State Street reported no notable items in the quarter.

takeaways.title: Interest income surges
takeaways.text: Net interest income rose 21% to $864M as the margin on earning assets widened by 16 basis points — the single biggest contributor to the 13% revenue growth.

takeaways.title: Record fees on record assets
takeaways.text: Servicing fees rose 10% and management fees 20%, both records, helped by higher market levels — assets under custody reached $59.2 trillion and assets under management $6.3 trillion.

takeaways.title: Eleventh straight quarter of operating leverage
takeaways.text: Revenue grew faster than the 8% rise in expenses, expanding the pre-tax margin to 34.6% — the eleventh consecutive quarter of positive year-over-year operating leverage excluding notable items, of which there were none.
